scope: Pinned terminfo.dev@4.0.0 termless criteria for modes.alt-screen.exit (the seeded ?1049 roundtrip), modes.altscreen-47, modes.altscreen-1047, reset.sgr (ESC[1;3;7m X ESC[0m Y, a case separate from sgr.reset) and reset.decaln (ESC # 8, cell 0,0) replayed byte-exactly on a disposable App main screen and graded from parent-journaled readScreen stored cells, cursor, active-buffer flag, margins, mode flags and history. modes.altscreen-47 and modes.altscreen-1047 are inconclusive by design in the pinned probe; that verdict is preserved and the visible-buffer effect contracts (ntilde.saved-reset.effect/v1) are graded separately with controls for no-op switches, shared bank contents, accidental main clearing, stale saved cursors and incomplete restoration. Active-screen reads only: the inactive bank is never inspected directly. reset.method, RIS, state stacks, pixels and the pinned DECALN pixel path are not claimed; no stock grades.
